meta.title: Sending only a new start time is silently ignored
gaps: The plan reads the round and verifies that starting_from is an epoch timestamp, but cannot verify that it remains unchanged or in the past because no prior starting_from value is available and lte requires a literal number.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, the request the case itself writes.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that Schema check: “starting from” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Insufficient parameters”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Schema check: “starting from” is a Unix timestamp in seconds.
